Type.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/17] The second part of our study utilized semistructured interviews with 12 consenting participants. Our interviews aimed to expand on the data gathered from the clinical records, specifically the depth and complexities of the participants' distress in a sociocultural and immigrant-specific context. Each interview lasted about 75 min and was conducted in the participant's native language.
